# nirvana_storage_bucket (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nirvana_storage_bucket" "example_storage_bucket" {
  bucket_id = "bucket_id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bucket_id` (String)
- `find_one_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the Bucket was created.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint of the Bucket's region. Point S3 clients at it, with an Object
Storage Key of the same project and region.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the Bucket, used to address it over S3.
- `object_count` (Number) Number of objects in the Bucket. Updated periodically, so it can lag behind
recent writes.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID the Bucket belongs to.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
Available values: "us-sva-2", "us-wdc-1".
- `signing_region` (String) Region S3 clients must sign their requests for (the SigV4 region). Configure
it as the region of any S3 client or SDK used with the Bucket.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Total size of the objects in the Bucket, in bytes. Updated periodically,
so it can lag behind recent writes.
- `status` (String) Status of the resource.
Available values: "pending", "creating", "updating", "ready", "deleting", "deleted", "error", "suspended".
- `tags` (List of String) Tags attached to the Bucket.
- `updated_at` (String) When the Bucket was updated.
- `url` (String) Path-style URL of the Bucket.

<a id="nestedatt--find_one_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `find_one_by`

Required:

- `project_id` (String) Project ID of resources to request

Optional:

- `name` (String) Filter by a case-insensitive substring of the Bucket name
- `region` (String) Filter by region
- `sort` (String) Comma-separated sort terms in precedence order, each field:asc or field:desc. Fields: created_at, updated_at, name, status, size_bytes, object_count
- `status` (String) Filter by Bucket status
Available values: "pending", "creating", "updating", "ready", "deleting", "error".
- `tags` (List of String) Filter by tags. Repeat the parameter to require several tags; a Bucket must carry all of them.
